bulletins.title: Career Counselling Centre Weekly Bulletin
bulletins.school: The Shri Ram School, Aravali & Moulsari

programs.title: UCAS Personal Statement Workshop
programs.overview: All about UCAS personal statement, admissions, scholarships, and student life in the UK.

programs.title: Alumni Podcast – College Unfiltered
programs.overview: The alumni podcast featured on the school YouTube channel in the CCC playlist. Conversations packed with valuable takeaways to help you prepare for your own college journey. Watch alumni from Brown University, King's College, and University of Warwick share their insights.

programs.title: CEMEx Online Summer Problem-Solving Course
programs.overview: Participants will be introduced to mathematical problem-solving techniques and can practice these techniques in major topic areas during the course.

programs.title: From Offers to Visas
programs.overview: Craflo is offering professional visa counselling services including end-to-end document review, timeline management and deadline tracking, interview preparation (where required), and personalised guidance to minimise delays or rejections.

programs.title: Harvard Undergraduate Science Olympiad (HUSO) 2026-27
programs.overview: HUSO is an undergraduate-run organization at Harvard University, dedicated to providing accessible STEM opportunities for high school students. Through its annual Science Olympiad Invitationals at Harvard, HUSO identifies and nurtures young scientific talent from around the world.

programs.title: Careers in Sports
programs.overview: Explore pathways and opportunities in the sports industry — from sports management to athletic training and beyond.

programs.title: Sustainability Project Building – Aranyaearth Foundation
programs.overview: Build your own UN SDG-aligned impact project while mastering design thinking and entrepreneurship. Earn a personalised LOR and UNESCO-affiliated certification. Get direct guidance from sustainability professionals. Build a standout portfolio with international credentials.

programs.title: IIT Madras 10-Day Machine Learning Boot Camp
programs.overview: 10-Day Journey: Master data analysis and machine learning basics. Learn to extract meaningful insights from real-world data. Build data literacy and critical thinking through interactive activities. Designed to spark creativity and prepare you for a future in data science.

programs.title: Indian Debating League 2026
programs.overview: Curated to help schools align early with key BP, WSDC, and global speech tournaments. The calendar enables informed tournament selection and structured preparation support for strong outcomes.

programs.title: Summer Residency Program by MISTI (MIT)
programs.overview: A 7-day program co-created with the MIT International Science and Technology Initiative (MISTI). For students enthusiastic about technology and interested in learning and building beyond the classroom.

programs.title: TribesforGOOD 2026 Summer Programs
programs.overview: Two programs: 4-WEEK Global Challenge & Social Justice, and 6-WEEK Social Entrepreneurship & Design Thinking. Designed to broaden perspectives and inspire creativity beyond traditional boundaries.

programs.title: FLAME University Summer Immersion – Design
programs.overview: A design immersion program by FLAME University combining creative thinking with hands-on design practice.

programs.title: International Astronomy and Astrophysics Competition 2026
programs.overview: For students curious about astronomy and science. Participate in a global competition testing your knowledge of the cosmos.

programs.title: BBLC – Life Lab Foundation
programs.overview: A prestigious platform for students to turn ideas into real-world scientific experiments. Gain access to global laboratories, present at scientific summits, and master authentic research practices. Builds leadership and collaboration skills with national recognition.

programs.title: NTU Singapore – GenAI Bootcamp
programs.overview: A 5-day programme introducing key areas of Generative AI, including foundations, AI co-pilots and assistants, and agentic AI concepts. Gain an overview of how these tools are applied across different contexts.

programs.title: 2026 Science Without Borders Challenge
programs.overview: This year's theme: Microscopic Marine Life — inviting young artists to explore tiny organisms that form the foundation of ocean ecosystems. Highlighting creativity and scientific curiosity.

programs.title: Bocconi Summer School 2026: An Italian Summer
programs.overview: Participate in two exciting laboratories and join an international community of students from all over the world at one of Europe's top business schools.

programs.title: The Lalit Summer School 2026 (3rd Edition)
programs.overview: Mixology workshop, culinary demonstration by professional chefs, bakery & pastry masterclass, farm-to-plate experiential learning, and educational visit to The Lalit Mangar.

programs.title: Oxford Mini Sustainability Summit
programs.overview: A sustainability-focused summit combining academic learning with practical problem-solving, in association with Oxford.

programs.title: Climate Change Challenge 2026
programs.overview: Develop innovative solutions to real-world climate challenges.

programs.title: IDL Tournament – Speech & Debate
programs.overview: This year's theme: The Shield & The Circuit — exploring the balance between protective institutions and cutting-edge innovations shaping 21st-century governance.

programs.title: ATLAS Summer School 2026 – Design, Business & Tech
programs.overview: Immersive summer experience helping students explore future career pathways through hands-on learning, expert mentorship, and exposure to industry-relevant skills.

programs.title: Tiger STRIPES – Virtual Internship & Workshops (RIT)
programs.overview: Engage in skill-building programs, internships, and competitions to earn badges, build a skill-based resume, and gain familiarity with Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT).

programs.title: Ecotourism Foundations & Sustainable Futures
programs.overview: Applied learning and guided field exposure to ecotourism, sustainability, conservation, and community-based tourism.

programs.title: Music Production & Creation – Summer 2026
programs.overview: Focus on music production and creation in a professional studio environment. Songwriting, recording, mixing, and collaborative projects. Limited to 20 students per batch.

programs.title: Build-up Internships 2026
programs.overview: Real-world, custom-sourced projects with top companies. Direct industry engagement through MOUs & company mentors. Interest-based matching, end-to-end mentorship, and dual certification.

programs.title: GeniusHub Summer Cohort 2026
programs.overview: Build a strong portfolio with real-world projects. Gain hands-on experience through guided mentorship. Showcase practical skills beyond academics.

programs.title: NextGen Labs: Learning Workshops by Masters' Union
programs.overview: Hands-on workshops in startups, app design, branding, stock investing, and AI — delivered by industry experts from Masters' Union.

programs.title: Summer Bootcamp by Masters' Union: Next-Gen Skills
programs.overview: Learn future-ready skills like content creation, app building, stock market fundamentals, and compete in Corporate MUN simulations.

programs.title: IIT & MoE – Free Coaching for CUET, JEE, NEET
programs.overview: Free entrance exam coaching covering JEE, NEET-UG, CUET-UG, and ICAR. Register online through the SATHEE portal.

programs.title: Penn STEP – Student Tutoring Empowerment Program
programs.overview: Supercharge your high school GPA. Earn a certificate from Thinklist. Experience transformational leadership development. Excel in math and gain self-awareness skills.

programs.title: Australia Connect Program
programs.overview: For students aspiring to study in a bachelor's program and work in Australia.

programs.title: Johns Hopkins University – Online Workshops
programs.overview: Virtual workshops by Johns Hopkins University exploring academic opportunities and building skills.
